content.comment_body: How can I create a bidirectional shift register that cycles between bit 0 and bit 8, with only one bit active at a time, and allows the work/pause time to be adjusted?
You might find useful examples at [url]. There is also an Automatic Shift Register sample project available at [url]. Best Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking to build a two-way, recurrent shift register with one bit moving at a time and user-adjustable timing pauses. Responses offer links to online documentation and sample files, highlighting that resources exist but the process is not natively intuitive within [company_name] software. Users may struggle to find direct, built-in features for such functionality, relying instead on examples or templates.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a simple way to set up an adjustable, recurrent one-bit shift register and looks for ready-made logic or clear instructions within [company_name]'s software.
